review.reason: Independently inspected modern sweet-natural-gas production-flaring proxy: one source MJ represents 1/36 m3 of the UVEK flare. Apply factor -1/36, including the reference-coordinate inversion; do not replace flaring with a gas turbine or purchased-fuel production. Both inventories follow the modern Meili-2021 approach: flaring includes resource withdrawal. Modern source comments assign CH4, NOx and SO2 to main production activities; neither inspected flare contains these flows. Full parent production inventories are not claimed equivalent. The source withdraws 1/36 standard m3 of natural gas per MJ; UVEK withdraws one standard m3 and emits 36 MJ waste heat per reference m3. Neither flare has technosphere suppliers, infrastructure, fuel-production inputs or recovered-energy credits. The exact market supplies -1 MJ of its corresponding flare without other active exchanges. UVEK replaces seven/eight modern source biosphere exchanges with nine: emission coefficients and pollutant coverage differ; source oxygen balancing is absent from UVEK, and UVEK adds nitrous oxide and waste heat. CO2 and NMVOC values also differ slightly. Norwegian observations, global extrapolation, time and volume-reference conventions are screening approximations; LCIA equivalence is not established or quantified. Preserve caller uncertainty, formulas, foreground suppliers, production and separate emissions; assess overlaps with separately represented production emissions independently. Only exact inspected ecoinvent 3.9--3.12 profiles are approved. Older sweet-gas profiles retain CH4/NOx in the flare and remain pending; all sour-gas profiles, patch versions and uninspected contexts remain outside this approval.
